messages:
Nina: Heads-up — customer onboards, runs the Node quickstart, prints "200 OK" but their UI never receives the streaming events. They only see content after they click "Enable streaming" in the workspace billing modal.
Ravi: Can you paste the exact Node logs? Is it an SDK-level on('data') never firing?
Nina: Logs: "request complete: 200" then promise resolves; no data events. They ran `node quickstart.js` with the same key and curl against /v1/streams returned chunks immediately.
Jules (devex): That sounds similar to billing-inactive fast-finish behavior we saw before. Is the workspace in a partial state (billing method missing) or a trial not activated?
Nina: Workspace shows "trial pending" in UI. The billing banner was present but the user thought 200 meant OK so they didn't click it.
BillingBot: Remind: streaming endpoints require active billing for full chunked streams. When billing is inactive we return a short non-chunked response to limit resource usage. See /docs/billing for details.
Liam (sdk): Actionable SDK fix: detect when a streaming request returns a full (non-chunked) body with a short length and the body contains "billing" or similar hints, then throw a BillingInactiveError instead of treating as success. That'll make quickstarts fail loudly (better than silent no-op).
Ravi: Agree. Also the Node fetch implementation treats 200 as a success and pipes the body; if no Transfer-Encoding: chunked header, our stream reader doesn't emit chunks. We need a heuristic.
Jules (devex): Backend side: return 402 with a single error chunk OR keep 200 but include an explicit envelope {"error":{"code":"billing_inactive","message":"..."}} as first chunk. Which is less breaking?
Liam (sdk): 402 + JSON chunk seems cleaner for programmatic detection. If we switch status codes, SDKs can short-circuit before setting up stream handlers.
Nina: Customer impact is high — they assumed quickstart was fine and closed the tab. We lost trust. We should also add a quickstart preflight check to show a warning if billing not active.
Jules (devex): Proposed tasks: 1) backend: update streaming gating behavior to return 402 with a small error chunk when billing inactive (jules -> infra), 2) SDKs: implement detection and raise BillingInactiveError for non-chunked/short responses (liam -> sdk), 3) quickstarts: add preflight /workspaces/me check and show explicit onboarding modal if billing inactive (nina -> devex-dx), 4) docs: add a troubleshooting note "200 but no streaming events" with repro and fix (docs-bot -> docs).
Ravi: Also add telemetry for first-call streaming-mismatch so we can measure how many new orgs hit this.
Liam (sdk): Quick hack: Node SDK will check headers: if content-length < 512 and content-type == application/json and request was stream-type -> throw BillingInactiveError with guidance link. I'll open a small patch.
Jules (devex): UX tweak: the console banner should include an inline "Run quickstart" preflight link that validates billing status with a single API call; if failing, show an inline CTA to add payment method.
Nina: I'll respond to the customer with the workaround (enable trial or add billing method) and promise a fix timeline.
BillingBot: Note: recommend docs update to mention service accounts and SSO flows where billing activation is deferred; those are most affected.
Docs-bot: I'll add the FAQ entry and a short troubleshooting snippet for the quickstart README.
Jules (devex): Let's aim to ship SDK patch and backend change in this sprint. Post in #announcements once done.
Nina: Thanks, everyone. I'll paste the user's logs and Sentry event here when available. :thumbsup:
